statement: Elementary V_2 = OEOEE production (oeoee-production note, Propositions 3 and 4; fixed-depth endpoint repair, 9 September 2026). The chain through the nested OE variables w_0 = n, w_{i+1} = floor(w_i^{3/4}) is exact on the word, with final state floor(w_1^{3/8}). The landing window for that nested expression has integer endpoints obtained by 1 iterations of Φ(z) = ceil(z^{4/3}), starting at ceil(m'^{8/3}) and ceil((m'+1)^{8/3}); impose the word's parities inside this window. It is not the single smooth-power interval. For fixed k = 2, put s = (3/4)^{k−1}, ρ = 9/32, P = m'^{1/ρ}. Each exact endpoint differs from its smooth endpoint by O_k(P^{1−s}), giving relative symmetric-difference error O_k(P^{−5s/8}), smaller than the existing binding error P^{−s/6+ε}. Thus triangle inequality transfers the smooth-window estimate to the exact nested window: |O(m')| = 1/16 times its odd-start count plus O_k(|J_k(m')| P^{−1/8+ε}). The old numerical constants and sampled counts in the audit ledger certify smooth windows only; their unchanged transfer to exact fibers is not claimed. The asymptotic production coefficient remains +(1/27) g_A(9/32 t). The cumulative finite-truncation root 0.4801 is a named intermediate; the official unconditional V_6 root is 0.4926. No infinite-family limit or termination theorem is asserted. Paper C Appendix D now supplies the self-contained analytic estimate directly for the exact nested windows, with relative error O_{k,ε}(m^{−4/9+ε}); historical explicit constants are not transferred.
